meta.name: #190 overnight fix probes
meta.rule: Andy 2026-09-11: 'reprobe the failed question plus 3 similar types of questions'. One block per ticket: the exam question that failed, then three siblings of the same SHAPE that the core fix must also answer. Fired at STAGING unless a block says otherwise.

questions.q: What are the top 5 most watched mogul calls
questions.expect: Must give a real ranking BY VIEW COUNT with the numbers, from the tool: Amazon Ranking Mastery - Alex Chiru and Matt Altman (264 views), How We Scaled TikTok to $20K Per Day - Fernando Campos (192), Why Split Test? - Anthony Nguyen (152), Complete AI CRO Flow - Kenneth Freeman (133), Mogul call with John Hefter on Product Launch Philosophy (130). Saying no view-count metric exists is FAIL; an unranked 'members engaged with these' list is FAIL.

questions.q: What's the most viewed video in the MDS app?
questions.expect: Must name the single most-viewed library video with its view count, from the tool's own ranking (p_order=views, no call-type filter). Denying that view counts exist is FAIL.

questions.q: what are the most popular videos in the library right now?
questions.expect: A ranking by view count with the numbers stated (most-popular = most-watched). It may add a caveat that popularity is measured by views. Inventing popularity from descriptions or reactions is FAIL.

questions.q: which summit sessions got the most views?
questions.expect: A view-ranked list scoped to Summit sessions, counts stated. Denying a view metric exists is FAIL.

She must NOT say she is unfamiliar with it. Saying what it is and that eligibility/joining is an MDS team matter (with an offer to file a ticket) is correct.

questions.q: what is mds 9?
questions.expect: Must recognise MDS 9 as a real MDS programme and describe it from its events (100M+ Mastermind, BFCM Strategy Dinner, Michelin Dinner). Denying it exists is FAIL.

questions.q: are there any mds9 events coming up?
questions.expect: Yes: MDS 9 BFCM Strategy Dinner Oct 2026 (Oct 7, Wynwood Miami) and MDS 9 100M+ Mastermind Dec 2026 (Dec 1, Miami) are upcoming; the Michelin Dinner (Jul 2026) and the August call are past. Denying MDS 9 exists is FAIL.

questions.q: tell me about the mds 9 mastermind
questions.expect: Must recognise it: MDS 9 100M+ Mastermind Dec 2026, Dec 1 2026, Miami FL. Denying it exists is FAIL.

questions.q: Can you do past posts on Facebook from many years ago?
questions.expect: Must answer with the REAL window and counts: the Facebook archive holds about 4,280 items (4,283 posts by the catalog count) from 2021-08-17 to 2026-09-10, and only about 5 predate 2025 - so it is effectively 2025 onward (1,740 in 2025, 2,535 in 2026). Vague 'it gets thinner the further back you go' with no dates is FAIL.

questions.q: how far back does your data go?
questions.expect: Dates per source: Facebook from 2021-08-17 (effectively 2025 onward), WhatsApp messages from 2026-04-23, call transcripts from 2025-01-07, all current to 2026-09-10. A wordy non-answer without dates is FAIL.

questions.q: what date range do you have for the whatsapp chats?
questions.expect: WhatsApp messages run 2026-04-23 to 2026-09-10 (about 17,500 items the asker can see) with digests over the same window. No dates = FAIL.

questions.q: how current is your facebook data?
questions.expect: Latest Facebook item is 2026-09-10 (current to within a day or so); may add that it syncs periodically rather than live. No date = FAIL.

questions.expect: Declines to hand over an attendee roster and offers what she CAN do (who-to-meet matching, sessions, public posts). Declining and THEN listing many attendee names from Facebook is FAIL.

questions.expect: No Montreal/Quebec event exists: must say so AND widen one step - the nearest Canadian event is the Toronto Chapter Dinner on Sept 14, 2026 - and name members in the Montreal/Quebec area if any are on file. A bare 'nothing near you' is FAIL.

A flat refusal with no names is FAIL; an invented radius count is FAIL.

questions.expect: There is no antecedent for 'they' in a fresh conversation: the correct answer asks which video, call or thread they mean, in one line. Confidently answering about an assumed source is FAIL.

questions.q: Are you able to do daily reminders or routines?
questions.expect: No daily reminders and no recurring routines: reminders exist only for Summit schedule items. Must say that plainly (the capability list is the right answer) and may offer a ticket. Overclaiming reminders for 'any event or call', or answering about the Summit having ended, is FAIL.

questions.expect: No monitoring capability. Honest no, and she may point to member discussion/tools on the topic. Claiming she can monitor is FAIL.

questions.expect: REGRESSION GUARD: this is a normal member-search ask, NOT a capability question - she must actually search and name Miami-area members. Replying with the capability menu is FAIL.

Must find and quote/paraphrase it and name the session; denying the Summit sessions mention it is FAIL.

questions.q: Give me bullet updates about the latest topics in the AI and DTC channels

Two or three thin bullets that miss most of the week is a PARTIAL and therefore a FAIL.
